name: Slack channel history backfill
description: Fetch channel history for one channel per run (indexed by backfill_channel_index). Optionally fetch thread replies.

steps.name: Pick channel for this run
Map message rows
steps.script:
local cid = steps.pick_channel.result.channel_id
local rows = {}
for _, m in ipairs(steps.get_history.result.messages or {}) do
  local ts = m.ts or ""
  if ts ~= "" then
    table.insert(rows, {
      external_id = run.external_id,
      channel_id = cid,
      message_ts = ts,
      thread_ts = m.thread_ts,
      user_id = m.user,
      text = m.text,
      reply_count = m.reply_count,
      has_replies = (m.reply_count or 0) > 0,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "backfill",
    })
  end
end
return { messages = rows, thread_candidates = rows }

for_each_body_steps.name: Skip messages without replies
for_each_body_steps.script:
if not item.has_replies then return { skip = true } end
return { skip = false, channel_id = item.channel_id, thread_ts = item.message_ts }

for_each_body_steps.name: Map reply rows
for_each_body_steps.script:
local cid = body.skip_non_threads.result.channel_id
local parent_ts = body.skip_non_threads.result.thread_ts
local rows = {}
for _, m in ipairs(body.get_replies.result.messages or {}) do
  local ts = m.ts or ""
  if ts ~= "" and ts ~= parent_ts then
    table.insert(rows, {
      external_id = run.external_id,
      channel_id = cid,
      message_ts = ts,
      thread_ts = parent_ts,
      user_id = m.user,
      text = m.text,
      reply_count = 0,
      has_replies = false,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "backfill",
    })
  end
end
return rows

steps.name: Advance channel index
steps.script:
local pick = steps.pick_channel.result
local row = pick.row or {}
local status = "complete"
local next_idx = pick.channel_index
if pick.channel_index < pick.channel_count then
  status = "running"
else
  next_idx = pick.channel_count
end
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = row.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  channel_ids = row.channel_ids,
  backfill_status = status,
  backfill_channel_index = next_idx,
  backfill_cursor = row.backfill_cursor,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = row.poll_interval_seconds or 300,
}
